prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
competitors_mentioned: Small business needing easy DIY social ads
answer_verbatim:
For most businesses, **Creatify** is probably the best dedicated AI video ad maker right now because it is built specifically for turning a product URL, images, or product description into short performance-style ads for TikTok, Meta, YouTube Shorts, and similar channels.

### Best choices by use case

| Use case | Best tool | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Best overall AI ad generator | **Creatify** | Product URL-to-video workflow, ad scripts, AI avatars, multiple ad variations |
| Best for UGC-style ads | **Arcads** | Strong focus on creator/actor-style vertical ads and rapid testing |
| Best realistic avatar spokesperson ads | **HeyGen** | Very good avatars, voiceovers, translations, and lip-sync |
| Best for fast social edits | **CapCut** | Easy templates, captions, editing tools, and trend-oriented formats |
| Best if you already use design tools | **Canva** | Simple brand kits, templates, resizing, and team collaboration |
| Best for polished brand/commercial content | **Adobe Express / Adobe Firefly** | Better fit for branded design workflows and Adobe users |
| Best for explainer/B2B avatar videos | **Synthesia** | Professional presenter-led videos, multilingual support, corporate workflows |

### My recommendation

- **E-commerce / DTC brand:** Start with **Creatify** or **Arcads**.  
- **App, SaaS, or local service business:** Use **HeyGen** or **Creatify**.  
- **Small business needing easy DIY social ads:** Use **Canva + CapCut**.  
- **B2B training, demos, or polished explainers:** Use **Synthesia** or **HeyGen**.

### What matters more than the tool

The strongest AI ad makers let you create **many hooks and variants**, not just one beautiful video. Look for:

- 9:16 vertical exports for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts
- Automatic captions
- Multiple scripts/hooks from one product page
- AI voices or licensed avatars
- Brand kit and logo integration
- Easy editing after generation
- Commercial-use rights and clear avatar/voice licensing
- Ability to export without platform watermarks

If you want one answer: **Creatify is the best first tool to try for performance-focused AI video ads; Arcads is the best alternative for UGC-style creative.**
